Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for assay CHEMBL1217644. Join assays on assay_id, activities on assay_id, molecule_dictionary on molregno for chembl_id, compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter to exact measurements: standard_relation = '=' and standard_value IS NOT NULL and standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
